title: Food Delivery App: Complete Design
description: Design food delivery app with OOP principles, class diagrams, and scalable C# implementations.

data.text: Design a food delivery app using object-oriented principles. Focus on clean class design, proper encapsulation, and extensible architecture.

data.caption: Interaction flow for Food Delivery App. Shows how components collaborate to fulfill a user request.
data.definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant S as FoodDeliveryAppService
    participant CU as Customer
    participant RE as Restaurant
    participant OR as Order
    participant DE as DeliveryAgent

    C->>S: Request
    S->>RE: PlaceOrder()
    RE-->>S: Result
    S->>OR: AcceptOrder()
    OR-->>S: Result
    S->>DE: Prepare()
    DE-->>S: Result
    S->>DE: Dispatch()
    DE-->>S: Result
    S-->>C: Response

data.title: food-delivery.Advanced.cs — Processor Pipeline
Design Principles Applied
data.text: Use composition over inheritance. Keep entities simple. Use interfaces to decouple services from implementations. Apply CQRS when read and write patterns diverge.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Encapsulate state inside entities; expose behavior, not data
Strategy and Command patterns make behavior pluggable
Dependency injection keeps classes loosely coupled
data.takeaway: Food Delivery App demonstrates how clean OOP design leads to maintainable, testable code that can evolve with requirements.
